newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico coffee growers plan bean image rally.
newsitem.headline: Mexico coffee growers plan bean image rally.

text.p: The Mexican Coffee Growers Confederation, the most influential producers' group in the country, will host a seven-day gathering next month to promote bean quality.
Coffee growers plan to meet in the Oaxacan state beach resort of Huatulco from March 10-16 to prepare a campaign boosting the image of the country's crop.
The confederation said in a statement it plans to promote the variety and quality of Mexican coffees to buyers, as well as educate national farmers on how to improve their crops.
Mexican coffee growers, long hit by punitive pricing because of their traditional poor-bean-quality image, wants to persuade the coffee trade otherwise.
The gathering will include conferences, a coffee quality contest and tips and new measures for improving quality.
